value.reason: Knowledge chunk provides clear, safe instructions for requesting a password reset, applicable to this account issue.

groundedReply.suggestedResponse: I'm sorry to hear you're having trouble signing in. You can request a password reset by going to the sign-in page and selecting the 'Forgot password' option. This will send a reset link to the email address associated with your account. Please note the link expires after 30 minutes and can only be used once, so be sure to click it soon after receiving it. If you don't see the email, please check your spam or junk folder, and confirm you're using the email address registered to your account. Let us know if you continue to have trouble.

citations.claim: Customer can request a password-reset email from the sign-in page; link expires after 30 minutes and works once; check spam and confirm correct account email.
